meta.circuit: brickwork 1D; per layer: random Clifford 1q (I/H/S/HS), RZ,RX small angle (theta_max 0.3), 1q noise, CNOT brickwork, per-qubit noise after each CNOT; noise = amplitude damping then depolarising; observable Z on the central qubit; input |0..0>; truncation: discard |c| < eps after every branching group.
meta.reference_note: actual error = |exact - truncated| where exact is dense Heisenberg Pauli-vector evolution with the true channels on the exact backward-cone sites (n=8 additionally cross-checked against density-matrix Schroedinger evolution with Kraus operators); no reference for n > 16.
